item.title: 复制效率
item.summary: 外部证据支持AI项目在单一工作流、共享平台和少数多站点场景中缩短周期或减少局部工作量，但还不能证明行业已获得可持续的跨客户复制经济。真正控制点不是模板数，而是把业务语义、数据、权限、评估、部署、运行和变更编码进可版本化平台，并用同cohort周期、人时、质量、失败和贡献毛利联合验收。当前阶段为pilot。
item.strategicPosition: 尚未通过主题内容门；当前只显示研究进度、实际引用来源和证据缺口。

agenda.question: {'answer': '部分工作流已缩短周期，但只有跨客户版本复用同时降低定制/维护人时并保持质量和贡献毛利，才算复制效率成立。', 'question': 'AI项目能否缩短周期、减少人力并跨客户复制？'}

synthesis.outlook_12_36m: 未来赢家将分化为三类：拥有业务语义与版本账本的平台、拥有标准运行与分发面的云、拥有行业方法和变革能力的交付网络。若同一版本在至少两个可比客户cohort中同时降低周期和定制/维护人时、保持生产质量并改善贡献毛利，阶段可转scaling；若只是POC和厂商案例增长，应保持pilot。
synthesis.strategic_summary: 外部证据支持AI项目在单一工作流、共享平台和少数多站点场景中缩短周期或减少局部工作量，但还不能证明行业已获得可持续的跨客户复制经济。真正控制点不是模板数，而是把业务语义、数据、权限、评估、部署、运行和变更编码进可版本化平台，并用同cohort周期、人时、质量、失败和贡献毛利联合验收。当前阶段为pilot。
synthesis.why_now: 模型和代码生成快速商品化，瓶颈正从能否做出原型转向能否把客户特定学习变成重复生产能力。与此同时，agent项目半数停在pilot、基础设施与治理导致取消、熟练开发者特定任务出现负生产率等反证，迫使市场从展示速度转向复制账本。
winner_conditions: 共享业务对象、数据和权限合同
版本级跨客户部署账本
定制与维护人时随复用下降
生产质量与合规不因复制退化
续约、扩张和贡献毛利可归因

evidence.source_quote: The pay-as-you-go-model for Anazon Bedrock has proven invaluable for helping them take advantage of the huge computing power needed to develop iteratively, while keeping costs under control. The organization has saved approximately 50 percent on development costs by using Amazon Bedrock versus writing the application from scratch.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: BDM is a productized vertical-agent case with reported operating-effort and development-cost compression.

evidence.source_quote: The main barriers to full implementation, respondents said, are concerns with security, privacy, or compliance, cited by 52%, followed by technical challenges to managing agents at scale, at 51%.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Independent media reports survey counterevidence on governance, security, and scale-management barriers.

evidence.source_quote: Volkswagen can roll out new key IT systems for production and logistics uniformly across all factories connected to the DPP. One example, called “Guided Vehicle Completion”, is a digital solution that helps optimize the coordination of complex processes in vehicle assembly, and is already in use at 13 plants across Volkswagen, Audi, and Volkswagen Commercial Vehicles.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Volkswagen is a multi-site production case testing whether data models and solutions can replicate across plants.

evidence.source_quote: “Accenture Edge offerings built with Google Cloud technology help mid-market organizations do exactly that. They can deploy solutions in weeks and get measurable outcomes at the scale, budget and speed that they need to grow."
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Independent media records a current packaged-industry and co-delivery attempt to compress mid-market deployments, with vendor claims labeled.

evidence.source_quote: With new features, Ada has grown its overall compute footprint by 30 percent since the migration. Yet, the company reduced compute costs by 15 percent over the same period. With more resources for optimization projects, Ada implemented a scaling controller that effectively uses Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2) Spot Instances , which take advantage of unused Amazon EC2 capacity and are available at up to a 90 percent discount compared to Amazon EC2 On-Demand Pricing. Ada has also started running some of its infrastructure on AWS Graviton processors , a family of processors designed to deliver excellent price performance for cloud workloads running on Amazon EC2. To further reduce costs, Ada is considering migrating additional workloads to AWS Graviton processors.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Ada illustrates the productized-AI archetype, where a shared runtime reduces platform effort and cost across customer deployments.

evidence.source_quote: AndesML , a retail media platform, helps large enterprises launch and monetize their own ad networks by showing the right ad to the right customer at the right time. Built on Vertex AI, BigQuery, and Gemini models, the AndesML platform has delivered a 30% performance lift in customer campaigns, accelerated production time by more than 30 days, and reduced operational costs.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Google's portfolio of customer-attributed cases is evidence of repeatable platform reach, but not a same-cohort success rate.

evidence.source_quote: Title: Measuring the Impact of Early-2025 AI on Experienced Open-Source Developer Productivity
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: METR's randomized controlled trial is counterevidence that AI coding assistance necessarily reduces expert delivery time.

evidence.source_quote: Today, as part of our Gemini at Work global event, we are showcasing nearly 50 new customer stories from organizations around the world to highlight just how impactful generative AI can be when you put it to work at scale — including PODS , Snap , Volkswagen US , Warner Bros. Discovery and many others. We’re inspired by what customers are building and excited by how quickly they’ve been able to move ideas from experimentation into production with our Vertex AI platform . We’re also seeing major boosts in productivity through Gemini for Google Workspace , with customers saving an average of 105 minutes per user, per week, according to our recent study of enterprise customers. 1
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Google reports a multi-customer portfolio and average time savings, useful for reach while retaining vendor and selection bias.

evidence.source_quote: After the prototype works in simple cases, scale up quality evaluation by broadening your set of beta testers and by collecting more customized feedback. This phase reveals blind spots such as unexpected topics, misunderstood queries, tools and retrieval gaps, or emerging usage patterns. It also expands your evaluation datasets.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Databricks explicitly retains requirements, data, evaluation, and production-improvement work despite reusable platform components.

evidence.source_quote: Description of the Matter As discussed in Note 2 to the consolidated financial statements, the Company generates revenue from the sale of subscriptions to access its software platforms in the Company’s hosted environment, along with ongoing operations and maintenance (“O&M”) services (“Palantir Cloud”); software licenses, primarily term licenses in the customers’ environments, with ongoing O&M services (“On-Premises Software”); and professional services. Management applies significant judgment in identifying and evaluating any non-standard terms and conditions in customer arrangements which may impact the determination of performance obligations or the timing of revenue recognition. Auditing revenue recognition was complex and required a significant level of auditor judgment to identify and evaluate non-standard terms and conditions that impact revenue recognition.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Palantir's audited filing exposes the labor, low-cost pilot, customer concentration, and service-delivery constraints behind rapid deployment.

evidence.source_quote: Databricks Marketplace gives data providers a secure platform for sharing data products that data scientists and analysts can use to help their organizations succeed. Databricks Marketplace uses OpenSharing to provide security and control over your shared data. You can share public data, free sample data, and commercialized data offerings. You can share data products in public listings or as part of private exchanges that you create, making listings discoverable only by member consumers. In addition to datasets, you can also share Databricks notebooks, machine learning models, and MCP servers to demonstrate use cases and provide tools that help customers succeed with agents.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Databricks Marketplace supplies distributable artifacts that can reduce rebuilding while leaving customer context unresolved.

evidence.source_quote: With user engagement surging to create over 30,000 new songs and driving over 730 million streams and counting, Splash is making a real-world impact beyond just the AI music space to all of music, from creation to listening. “Our top five creators are getting so many streams that they would be in the global top 100 if measured against mainstream music-streaming platforms,” says Chan. And behind the spike in engagement, training costs for Splash’s generative music models dropped 54 percent and training time fell 50 percent because of the burst capabilities that helped the team to accelerate training and efficiently reuse the same hardware for lower-capacity inference.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Splash Music is a bounded co-delivery case showing that expert focus and reusable infrastructure can compress model-development time and cost.

evidence.source_quote: By harnessing the power of generative AI, Georgia-Pacific set a new standard for knowledge management and issue resolution in large-scale manufacturing. “We’re just beginning, but we estimate millions in potential savings annually across our facilities through the use of generative AI technology,” says Shah.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Georgia-Pacific shows a production workflow and an expansion opportunity while labeling savings as an estimate, not realized cross-site economics.

evidence.source_quote: Team members can use Amazon Q Developer for assistance with code generation, testing, and debugging. They can also get help with business questions, their code base, and other topics related to enterprise data. Using the service, DTCC engineers can transform and implement new code to meet their specific requests. During the POC, the company boosted developer throughput by 40 percent, accelerating product development by saving many hours a week. “During our POCs, we found that something that used to take 10 hours now takes 6 hours using Amazon Q Developer,” says Powell. “That is quite powerful.” The company also reduced code defects and the associated operational risks by 30 percent while improving test coverage during the POC. Throughout the use of Amazon Q Developer, build-failure rates did not increase.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: DTCC provides a phased production rollout with measured development and defect outcomes, while still separating POC from scale.

evidence.source_quote: Leveraging cutting-edge generative AI models, NAB has boosted productivity by 18%—with 40% of production code coming from AI-generated suggestions rather than manual input. This has redefined NAB’s approach to coding, driving greater automation and advancing its technological capabilities.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: NAB provides a regulated-enterprise rollout and measured developer output, with organization-change limits retained.

evidence.source_quote: Nevertheless, Etsy still saw some unexpected variability in costs. “You will have data scientists, developers, and engineers testing new ideas that potentially come up with great results for our sellers and buyers. However, when they are testing it, we are seeing spikes in costs,” says Daya. Etsy saw these unexpected costs as an opportunity to increase cost visibility among the company’s teams. “Dany (Daya) was an early adopter of several Google Cloud Billing and Cost Management features, and we wanted to give that same visibility to everyone, to introduce accountability across the company about each person’s impact on cost,” explains Jack Perkins, Data Analyst at Etsy. That meant making cost data accessible with reporting views that made sense to everyone.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Etsy is a platform customer case for shared AI infrastructure; only body-verified replication claims will be used.

evidence.source_quote: On the development side, the results were just as concrete. Tecban estimated a 30% productivity gain in development and 14% in testing, reinforcing GitHub Copilot's role as a technical accelerator within the broader strategy. The same momentum showed up in day-to-day activities: "An analysis that used to take 4 hours and 47 minutes is now done in 2 minutes and 35 seconds. In another case, it dropped from 1 hour and 35 minutes to 52 seconds," notes Fabio Viel dos Santos, Process Manager at Tecban.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Tecban reports cross-workflow productivity while preserving governance and fragmentation as scaling constraints.

evidence.source_quote: DDN's report reveals the considerable role that third parties play, with 72% relying on external expertise and only 12% depending solely on in-house teams. This is notable, because 83% agree that teams are struggling today and 98% admit to AI skills gaps, further underscoring the need for outside help.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Independent media reports infrastructure and skill barriers that can erase template-level replication gains.

evidence.source_quote: Title: An Empirical Study of Production Incidents in Generative AI Cloud Services
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: A production-incident study constrains claims that a reusable cloud stack removes operational replication costs.
